panels.description: Minutes since most recent ingested event. LIVE = data flowing normally.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  max(timestamp) AS time,
  greatest(dateDiff('minute', max(timestamp), toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})), 0) AS lag_minutes
FROM ${summary_minute}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Data freshness trend; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Data Freshness

panels.description: Total request volume for the current window.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  cnt_all AS value
FROM ${table}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Total Requests; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Total Requests

panels.description: Percentage of traffic classified as bot-like (isBotTraffic=true). Delta in percentage points vs baseline.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  round(countMergeIf(`count()`, trafficCohort IN ('Bot', 'AI')) * 100.0 / greatest(cnt_all, 1), 2) AS value
FROM ${table}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__adHocFilter()

GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Bot share trend; du=${__user.login}'

panels.description: 2xx success rate for governance pages (robots.txt, sitemap.xml, ads.txt, llms.txt). Should be >99%.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  round(countMergeIf(`count()`, statusCode >= 200 AND statusCode < 300) * 100.0 / greatest(cnt_all, 1), 2) AS value
FROM ${table}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND resourceCategory IN (${resourceCategories})
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Policy page status trend; du=${__user.login}'

panels.description: Rate-limiting (429) and server error (5xx) rates over time.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  round(countMergeIf(`count()`, statusCode = 429) * 100.0 / greatest(cnt_all, 1), 2) AS rate_429,
  round(countMergeIf(`count()`, statusCode >= 500 AND statusCode < 600) * 100.0 / greatest(cnt_all, 1), 2) AS rate_5xx
FROM ${table}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Reliability Trend (429 + 5xx Rate); du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: AI Traffic Trend

panels.description: ASNs driving AI-labeled traffic, ranked by volume. Gradient gauge on share column.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  asn,
  country AS Country,
  cnt_all AS Requests
FROM ${table}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND trafficCohort = 'AI'
GROUP BY asn, country
ORDER BY Requests DESC
LIMIT 10
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top AI sources; du=${__user.login}'

  uniqExactIf(asn, notEmpty(asn)) AS value
FROM ${table}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__adHocFilter()

panels.title: Unique ASN Count

panels.description: ASN analysis: ASNs with the largest absolute volume delta between the selected window and the immediately preceding equal-length baseline.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
   toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS current_start,
   toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds}) AS current_end,
   greatest(dateDiff('second', current_start, current_end), 1) AS window_seconds,
   current_start - INTERVAL window_seconds SECOND AS baseline_start
 SELECT
   asn AS Entity,
   countMergeIf(`count()`, timestamp >= current_start AND timestamp <  current_end) AS Current,
   countMergeIf(`count()`, timestamp >= baseline_start AND timestamp <  current_start) AS Baseline,
   toInt64(Current) - toInt64(Baseline) AS Delta,
   abs(Delta) AS abs_delta
 FROM ${table}
 WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) - INTERVAL window_seconds SECOND
   AND timestamp < toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
   AND $__adHocFilter()
   AND notEmpty(asn)
 GROUP BY Entity
 ORDER BY abs_delta DESC
 LIMIT 10
 SETTINGS
   hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
   hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=ASNs by Delta (Top 10); du=${__user.login}'
